STORY_MODE_COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION.en:
Delve into the world of Rogue One, 
as you journey across three planets unlocking 
all your favourite characters along the way.

Test your skills and see if you have 
what it takes to lead the Rebellion.


Coming Soon
STORY_MODE_COMING_SOON_DESCRIPTION.zh:
深入侠盗一号的世界，穿越三个星球，解锁所有你喜爱的角色。

测试你的技能，看看你是否具备领导义军的能力。


即将推出
